complex_stoichiometry: one imidazole plus one salicylic acid

connectivity.imidazole: five-membered ring N1-C2-N3-C4-C5-N1 with N1-H; C2, C4, and C5 each bear one H
connectivity.salicylic_acid: benzene ring bearing adjacent carboxylic-acid and phenolic substituents; carboxyl carbon bonded to C(=O)O-H and phenolic oxygen bonded to H; four aromatic C-H sites

environment: isolated gas-phase molecular complex; no solvent or periodic boundary
interaction_energy_definition: E(complex) - E(imidazole monomer) - E(salicylic_acid monomer), using one consistent electronic-structure protocol and energy unit
required_candidate_identity: retain a stable candidate identifier, optimized geometry, and the intermolecular donor/acceptor contacts used to distinguish duplicates
